image_note: Images and floor plans are published by Binghatti, the developer of Binghatti Skyrise, on its own project page, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the building. They are computer renders showing the developer's intended specification — they are not photographs of any particular apartment, and the finish of an individual unit may differ. Ask to view before relying on them.
caveats: Binghatti Skyrise is under construction with handover expected in Q4 2026, so no tenancy contracts are registered against it yet and no rent or yield can be shown. The sale prices are registered off-plan sales.
